text:
1  FIXED SUPPORT FRAMES
Two 5 x 7 frames + cross ties
Keep the gearbox rigid

2  MOTOR BRACKET
9L spine, pins and spacer
Holds the motor on the frame

3  EV3 MEDIUM MOTOR
Powers the fork-lifting motion
One motor for the complete lift

4  REDUCTION GEARBOX
Two 8T-to-24T stages = 9:1
Slower motion, greater torque

5  PARALLEL LIFT ARMS
Four 7L beams, two per side
Keep the forks level as they rise

6  MOVING CARRIAGE
Two upright 9L beams + ties
Carry the forks up and down

7  FORK BRACKETS
White 3 x 5 right-angle beams
Join each fork to the carriage

8  FORKS
Two forward-facing 9L beams
Slide under and lift a pallet

9  DRIVE AXLE + COUPLERS
Turn both lower arms together
